title: 3D RANS against the quasi-3D wing: one planform, five NACA sections (experimental extension)

section_states.xfoil: XFOIL state: section aerodynamics from the vortex-sheet surface model trained on XFOIL
section_states.sst: SST state: section aerodynamics from the RANS field decoder trained on AirfRANS k-omega SST (wall pressure integrated plus wall-function friction)

setup.quasi3d: classical Phillips-Snyder nonlinear lifting line with a relaxed free wake; induced drag C_Di in the Trefftz plane; C_D = C_Di + C_D0, C_D0 the section profile drag integrated over the span; coefficients on the exact planform area
setup.rans: OpenFOAM v2112 simpleFoam, k-omega SST, wall functions; coarse snappyHexMesh mesh (cell counts per section), half model with a symmetry plane; C_L, C_D are means over the last 10% of the iterations; a finer mesh for NACA 2412 in mesh_check_naca2412
setup.definitions: rel_err = quasi-3D / RANS - 1; d = quasi-3D - RANS; cl_rms = RMS over the half span's strips of the c_l difference; loading = c c_l / c_bar with c_bar = S/b; convergence ranges = max - min over the last 25% of the iterations

spanwise_loading_naca2412_6deg.note: RANS: the strip sum is the sampled-surface C_L (checked). Quasi-3D: the strip sum slightly exceeds the lifting line's C_L, since a strip's c_l acts normal to its local flow (freestream plus induced velocity) while C_L projects the force on the freestream lift direction
